package: K35-T1 Chromium playback of the replacement original through the local HLS Worker

result.database: disposable PostgreSQL 17.11 after all 84 Prisma migrations; container stopped after test
assertions: Chromium plays the initial HLS original beyond 0.5 seconds through the local Worker
owner replaces the original through Studio multipart HTTP and the real FFmpeg worker
Chromium reloads the same video after replacement and plays beyond 0.5 seconds
browser requests for v2~<attemptId> include the master playlist and fMP4 segment through workers/hls-edge/worker.mjs
Studio DELETE then removes the video and its original/HLS objects through the durable cleanup runner

limitations: This is local PostgreSQL, loopback S3-shaped storage and local Worker code; it does not verify Cloudflare R2, a deployed Worker or production rollout.
K35 role/state and payment profiles, adversarial crash boundaries and independent review remain open.
